events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: A Legend's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Timeless Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped 61 years ago today, a truly pivotal moment in music history. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world tragically lost music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we said goodbye to John Lennon. His music and message of peace live on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose influence is still heard everywhere.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy would-be 92nd birthday to the one and only Elvis Presley! His legacy is simply unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the incredible Jimmy Page! That guitar work still gives us chills.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rocker's Birthday
angles.copy: The legendary Rod Stewart is 82 today! Still got that distinctive rasp and incredible stage presence.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the one and only Suggs! What's your favourite Madness tune to get you up and skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', turns 71 today.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still love those 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the icon, the legend, Dolly Parton! Her music and spirit are truly timeless.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting maestro, a true British music legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Grammy-winning British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Those soulful tunes still sound incredible.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, honouring pioneers like The Beatles, Bob Dylan, and The Rolling Stones.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first ever Rock & Roll Hall of Fame inductions. Which artist would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming the nation after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary Genesis drummer and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Music Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incomparable Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, a true musical force.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his charming roles, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: British Charm Turns 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the wonderfully charming Hugh Grant! What's your favourite of his classic British rom-coms?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake! Still bringing the moves and the hits.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Pop Larkin, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: National Treasure's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. What's your favourite of his unforgettable characters?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, who tragically lost their lives in a plane crash on this day in 1959.

angles.name: A Tragic Day in Music
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost three music pioneers in 'The Day The Music Died'. Their songs live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Rickrolling Legend
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering the reggae legend Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Reggae Royalty
angles.copy: Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music and message of unity are as powerful as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Celebrated singer-songwriter Carole King, known for 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Songwriting Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! Her songs have shaped generations of music.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost her, Whitney Houston's voice still gives us chills. What's your favourite Whitney track?

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Pop Heartbreak
angles.copy: Remember the day Take That broke up? Thirty-one years ago today, it was front-page news! Thankfully, they came back.

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Reggae Pop King
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing those smooth reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Ed!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer-songwriter?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: The Quiet Beatle's Day
angles.copy: George Harrison would have turned 84 today. His incredible songwriting and spirit live on.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: The Who's legendary frontman Roger Daltrey celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic voice of The Who, Roger Daltrey! Still smashing it after all these years.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: 80s pop sensation Nik Kershaw, known for hits like 'Wouldn't It Be Good', celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw! Still sounds good, wouldn't it?

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Coldplay frontman Chris Martin celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Coldplay Frontman at 50
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay's Chris Martin! Half a century of incredible music and stadium-filling anthems.

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Bon Jovi frontman Jon Bon Jovi celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Star Turns 65
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary Jon Bon Jovi! Still rocking and living on a prayer.

events.title: Chris Rea would have been 76
events.blurb: Remembering the distinctive voice of Chris Rea, who would have celebrated his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Driving Home For Memories
angles.copy: Chris Rea would have been 76 today. His unique sound and timeless tracks continue to resonate.

events.title: Mary Wilson would have been 83
events.blurb: Remembering The Supremes co-founder Mary Wilson, who would have celebrated her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Motown Icon
angles.copy: Mary Wilson of The Supremes would have been 83 today. Her incredible talent helped define the Motown sound.

events.title: Michael Jackson's Moonwalk Debut
events.blurb: On this day in 1983, Michael Jackson debuted his iconic Moonwalk during his performance of 'Billie Jean' at Motown 25.

angles.name: Moonwalk History
angles.copy: Forty-four years ago today, Michael Jackson changed the game with his first televised Moonwalk. An unforgettable moment in TV and music!

events.title: Gary Numan turns 69
events.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Gary Numan celebrates his 69th birthday today.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the influential Gary Numan! Still sounding absolutely fantastic.
